The March 15, 2024 order is in PST (UTC-8), so the dashboard shows 16:30 instead of 15:30. The same fixed-offset approach would also be wrong for CA in summer, so a proper fix would use zoneinfo ("America/Los_Angeles") rather than a hardcoded offset.
